---
title: "Mathematics"
subtitle: "Display math stays inside the measure"
---

Display mathematics may scroll locally. The normal body measure is 630px;
the site-wide wide profile uses 780px. The compact Copy control appears on hover
or keyboard focus and copies the source without its surrounding `$$` delimiters.
If clipboard access is unavailable, selectable source appears below the formula.
After a successful copy, the button itself shows `Copied!` with a green outline
for about two seconds, then returns to `Copy`.

$$
\omega_r = 2\pi f
$$ {#eq-frequency}

Native references such as @eq-frequency keep their numbering and links.

$$
\mathcal{R}(x) = \sum_{k=1}^{n} \frac{\alpha_k\,\exp\left(-\frac{(x-\mu_k)^2}{2\sigma_k^2}\right)}{\sqrt{2\pi}\sigma_k} + \int_0^\infty \frac{\lambda^2 + \omega^2 + \eta^2}{(\lambda + \omega + \eta)^2}\,d\omega.
$$

Inline mathematics stays in the sentence, as in $\omega_r = 2\pi f$.

## Copy settings

::: {.callout-warning title="Copy in HTTP previews"}
Use an HTTPS site when checking Copy on mobile Safari. An HTTP preview at a
LAN or VPN address is not a secure context, even over a VPN, so Safari does
not expose the standard clipboard API. Copy may therefore fail on these
previews; select the LaTeX source shown below the formula and copy it manually.

Check Copy again on the HTTPS site. Browser permissions can still prevent
clipboard access. See [WebKit's clipboard security requirements](https://webkit.org/blog/10855/async-clipboard-api/#security-and-privacy).
:::

At site level in `_quarto.yml`, set `askr.math-copy: false` as a nested option:

```yaml
askr:
  math-copy: false
```

A page uses the flat front-matter key `askr-math-copy: false`. A page value
overrides the site setting; `askr-math-copy: true` enables it on that page.
For one equation, use a wrapping div with `.no-math-copy`, or add that class
to the native equation attributes (`$$ … $$ {#eq-name .no-math-copy}`).
Display equations in tight lists also support Copy. The original source stays
in a data attribute; the selectable fallback is created only after a denied copy.
Search retains Quarto's native equation text without an extra Askr source copy.

## Native semantic blocks

Use Quarto's native identifiers (`def-`, `thm-`, `prp-`, `lem-`, `cor-`,
`rem-`, `exm-`) and `.proof` for numbered definitions, theorems, propositions,
lemmas, corollaries, remarks, examples and proofs.

::: {#def-angular-frequency}
## Angular frequency

Angular frequency is $\omega = 2\pi f$ for frequency $f$.
:::

::: {.proof}
One cycle is $2\pi$ radians, so multiplying cycles per second by $2\pi$
gives radians per second.
:::

## Limits

The theme contains a long display formula by scrolling inside the measure.
Do not encode a sentence as display mathematics. Name the quantity in prose,
and keep the formula to the relation.
